versions.content: The name of the Application Types Header File shall be formed by prefixing the AUTOSAR software-component type name with Rte_[Byps_] and appending the result with _Type.h . [Byps_] is an optionnal infix used when compo- nent wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related software component type (See chapter 4.9.2).
